entry.title: Generativetober Day 23 - Dapper
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Walker {
  constructor(x, y, c, leftbound, rightbound, topbound, botbound) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.leftbound = leftbound;
    this.rightbound = rightbound;
    this.topbound = topbound;
    this.botbound = botbound;
    this.color = c;
    this.tx = 0;
    this.ty = 10000;
    this.visited = [];
  }

  update() {
    this.tx += 0.01;
    this.ty += 0.01;
    this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -5, 5);
    this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -3, 3);
    
    if (this.x < this.leftbound) this.x = this.leftbound;
    else if (this.x > this.rightbound) this.x = this.rightbound;

    if (this.y < this.topbound) this.y = this.topbound;
    else if (this.y > this.botbound) this.y = this.botbound;

    if (random() < 0.25) {
      this.visited.push([this.x,this.y]);
    }
  }

  show() {
    stroke(0, 55);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.visited.length; ++i) {
      // hack for line length, replace with width probably
      line(this.visited[i][0]-50, this.visited[i][1], 
           this.visited[i][0]+50, this.visited[i][1]);
    }
  }
}

class Dapper {
  constructor(x, y, w, h) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.w = w;
    this.h = h;
    this.walker = new Walker(x+w/2, y+h, 0,
                            10+w/2, // left boundary
                            width-w/2-10, // right boundary
                            height/2, // top boundary
                            height-10); // bottom boundary
  }

  update() {
    this.walker.update();
    this.x = this.walker.x - this.w/2;
    this.y = this.walker.y - this.h;
  }

  show() {
    // path
    this.walker.show();
    
    // body
    stroke(0);
    fill(0);
    rect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);

    // undercolor
    stroke(255);
    fill(255);
    triangle(this.x, this.y + this.h/4,
            this.x+this.w, this.y + this.h/4,
            this.x+this.w/2, this.y + this.h/1.5);
    const underheight = (this.y + this.h/1.5) - (this.y + this.h/4);

    // accents
    stroke(magenta);
    fill(magenta);
    const centerline = this.x + this.w/2;
    const accenty = this.y + this.h/4 + underheight/9;
    const accentwidth = this.w / 10;
    const accentheight = accentwidth / 1.5;
    triangle(centerline, accenty,
            centerline-accentwidth, accenty - accentheight,
            centerline-accentwidth, accenty + accentheight);
    triangle(centerline, accenty,
            centerline+accentwidth, accenty - accentheight,
            centerline+accentwidth, accenty + accentheight);
  }
}

let d;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640,640);
  background(cyan);
  d = new Dapper(width/3, height/2-100, 100, 200);
}

function draw() {
  background(cyan);
  d.update();
  d.show();

  stroke(255);
  fill(0);
  textSize(16);
  text("Dapper", 10, height - 10);
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("dapper.png");
  }
}

Discussion

I got nothin' here... Dapper? I ended up first making a little dapper dude with proportionally drawn tuxedo and bow tie and then decided to make him walker around on a plane drawing faded lines for his path. I like only drawing some of the lines and drawing them with some alpha. I want to explore this more.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 22 - Beacon
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function showTitle() {
  stroke(75);
  fill(75);
  textSize(16);
  text("Beacon", 10, height - 10);
}

class Star {
  constructor(x, y) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.color = random(colors);
    this.isBeacon = false;
    this.tbright = random(0, 10000);
    this.alph = random(50, 255);
  }

  setBeacon(isBeacon) {
    this.isBeacon = isBeacon;
  }

  update() {
  }

  show() {
    stroke(...this.color, this.alph);
    circle(this.x, this.y, random());
    if (this.isBeacon) {
      stroke(...this.color, random(0, 255));
      const n = random(0,5);
      line(this.x - n, this.y, this.x + n, this.y);
      line(this.x, this.y - n, this.x, this.y + n);
    }
  }
}

const stars = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    stars.push(new Star(random(0,width), random(0,height)));
  }

  random(stars).setBeacon(true);
  
  showTitle();
}

function draw() {
  background(0);
  
  for (let s of stars) {
    s.update();
    s.show();
  }

  showTitle();
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("beacon.png");
  }
}

Discussion

Today's prompt is better viewed animated I think than static. It's the first prompt where what I envisioned before starting was imagined first as an animation rather than a static image. A beacon in this case is a brighter blinking star.

The blinking beacon star is pretty mundane as far as code goes here but what I thought was a nice touch was the flickering of the other stars. I wanted something that gave the appearance of flickering stars and started out with all sorts of noise calculations but a simple random on the radius of the circle between 0 and 1 was the nicest. Obviously stars don't all flicker this intensely in the real sky but I think it gave the animation a certain vibe that implies the dots should be seen as "stars" and not just random dots on a field. It's interesting that my brain wanted to see some sort of flickering behavior in order to see them as stars when in reality it's not quite the same. Almost as if in order for me to see what I representationally imagined I needed to make the representation non-conforming in some way compared to reality.

Something else that might be a nice improvement to this would be clustering of sorts rather than uniform randomness of the star locations. When you look through a telescope it's often the case to see a slight clustering or grouping of stars, sometimes in the same color.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 21 - Hero
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255, 255, 255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Walker {
  constructor(x, y, c) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.color = c;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.tx = random(0, 100);
    this.ty = random(999, 9999);
    this.r = width/3.5;
  }

  update() {
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    if (random() > 0.5) {
      this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -5, 5);
    } else {
      this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -5, 5);
    }
    
    this.tx += 0.02;
    this.ty += 0.02;
  }

  show() {
    let centerdist = dist(this.x,this.y,width/2,height/2);
    let aph = map(centerdist, 0, this.r, 200, 0);
    if (centerdist > this.r) {
      this.x = width/2;
      this.y = width/2;
    }
    stroke(...this.color, aph);
    line(this.lastx, this.lasty, this.x, this.y);
  }
}

let walkers = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  stroke(255);

  const r = width/3.5;
  const h = height/2;
  const w = width/2;
  for (let i = 0; i < 2*PI; i += 0.08) {
    let x = r * cos(i) + w;
    let y = r * sin(i) + h;
    stroke(magenta);
    circle(x,y,1);

    if (random() < 0.5) {
      stroke(...white, 200);
      line(x, y, x + random(-75, 75), y);
    } else {
      stroke(...cyan, 225);
      line(x, y, x, y + random(-50, 50));
    }
  }

  for (let j = 0; j < 10; ++j) {
    walkers.push(new Walker(width/2, height/2, magenta));
  }
  
  noStroke();
  fill(magenta);
  textSize(16);
  text("Hero", 10, height - 10);
}

function draw() {
  for (let w of walkers) {
    w.update();
    w.show();
  }
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("hero.png");
  }
}

Discussion

Today's prompt was difficult. When I read the word "Hero" I thought of a point of light in my head. I don't know why I had that reaction but I guess it could mean something. I decided for the piece I wanted something circular. The sun is a hero in some ways. Didn't want to make a crude landscape with a sun, I think it would look silly. I'm starting to feel like leaning more into symbolic or just very tenuous thoughts or feelings linking to the prompt. I'm not super happy with the landscape-like or more direct creation of objects I've done thus far. Like Cactus, which was fun to make but otherwise I'm not that happy with it. It feels a bit too representational.

I made a circle of white dots similar to how I started mystical awhile back. From there I added random short line segments extending from those points. At that point I had my piece. I don't know why but for some reason seeing the circle of points and the lines and how they prompted my mind into filling in the circle I knew that's where I wanted this to go. The center also followed quickly for some reason. I like how when you leave the animation going for a long time the center magenta "crackling" seems to make an eye looking off in some seemingly random direction. In a way the piece feels symbolic and accidentally representational.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 20 - Lounge
entry.content:

const white = [255, 255, 255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  noFill();

  let n = 100;
  let buffer = 20;
  let slice = (width - buffer) / n;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    stroke(...magenta, map(i, 0, n, 50, 255));
    bezier(
      slice + slice*i, 10, // anchor 1 (start)
      width/n, height/1.5, // control 1
      width-width/n, height-height/n, // control 2
      width - slice*i, height-30  // anchor 2 (end)
    );
  }
  
  noStroke();
  fill(...magenta, 175);
  textSize(16);
  text("Lounge", 10, height - 10);
}

  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("lounge.png");

entry.content:

const white = [255, 255, 255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

async function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  stroke(255);
  fill(255);
  textSize(16);
  text("Confused", 10, height - 10);

  // black and white pattern
  patternImg = createGraphics(2, 2);
  patternImg.noStroke();
  patternImg.background(250);
  patternImg.fill(40);
  patternImg.rect(0, 0, 1, 1);
  patternImg.rect(1, 1, 1, 1);
  let ctx = drawingContext;
  let pattern = ctx.createPattern(patternImg.canvas, 'repeat');
  ctx.fillStyle = pattern;

  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    rotate(random(0, PI));
    noStroke();

    if (random() < 0.1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = pattern;
    } else {
      fill(random(colors));
    }
    
    triangle(random(0,width), random(0,height),
            random(0,width), random(0,height),
            random(0,width), random(0,height));
    square(random(0,width), random(0,height), random(5, 50));
    circle(random(0,width), random(0,height), random(5, 50));
    rect(random(0,width), random(0,height), random(5, 50), random(5, 50));
    ellipse(random(0,width), random(0,height), random(5,50), random(5,50));

    stroke(random(colors));
    line(random(0,width), random(0,height), random(width), random(height));
    arc(random(0,width), random(0,height), random(5, 50), random(5, 50),
       random(0, PI), random(0, PI));

    noFill();
    bezier(random(0,width), random(0,height),
          random(0,width), random(0,height),
          random(0,width), random(0,height),
          random(0,width), random(0,height));
  }
}

}

  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("confused.png");
  }
